maddeler.e:
استعجلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَلُوا (istaʕjalū) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اُسْتُعْجِلُوا (ustuʕjilū) /us.tuʕ.d͡ʒi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اِسْتَعْجِلُوا (istaʕjilū) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
